name: Kosmos-1267
about: Kosmos-1267 (1981-039A), a crewed vehicle (TKS), launched 1981 Apr 25. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (DK).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (1981 May 25), held fixed
